name: mmm-tilings
description: MagicMirror² module: animated tilings-theory simulations (Lorenz attractor, diverging pendulums, fractal basins, logistic map, symmetric icons, the three-body problem, chaotic billiards, rule 30), and pages of physics and mathematics: a Bohr-style atom and hydrogen's orbitals, a fractal zoom, sacred geometry, the planets' dance, Chladni figures, aperiodic and hyperbolic tilings, snow crystals, and tonight's sky.
author: Charles West
